fields.summary: Newcastle University's one-year MSc Computer Science costs £33,400 in tuition for 2027-28. See the first-year cost, scholarships and India entry grades.
fields.seo_title: Newcastle University for Indian Students: Fees & Entry 2027
fields.meta_description: Newcastle University for Indian students: MSc tuition, scholarships, India entry grades (60% for a 2:1), visa money and deadlines for 2027 entry.
fields.body_md:
## At a glance

Newcastle University teaches its postgraduate courses from its Newcastle city centre campus. This guide covers three one-year master's courses for September 2027 entry: MSc Computer Science, MSc Data Science and the MBA.

The most important thing to know is the cost. Tuition for MSc Computer Science is **£33,400** a year for 2027-28 entry. Scholarships can lower the amount you pay, so read the scholarships section before you budget.

| Fact | Detail |
|---|---|
| Campus | Newcastle city centre campus |
| Course length | 12 months, full time |
| Start | September 2027 |
| Tuition, MSc Computer Science | **£33,400** a year |
| Tuition deposit for students from India | **£3,000**, or an official sponsorship letter |
| English test | IELTS (see Getting in) |

## What it really costs

You pay for three things: tuition, a deposit, and the money you must show for your visa.

### Tuition

International tuition for 2027-28 entry is:

- MSc Computer Science: **£33,400** a year
- MSc Data Science: **£32,800** a year
- MBA: **£34,400** a year

Each course lasts 12 months full time.

### Deposit

Students from India must pay a tuition deposit of **£3,000** by **27 August 2027**, or send an official sponsorship letter by the same date. A deposit is an upfront payment that secures your place. A sponsorship letter is an official letter from the person or organisation paying for your studies. If your course needs an ATAS certificate, the date is **13 August 2027**.

### Money for the visa

The UK student visa needs proof that you can pay your living costs. Newcastle is outside London, so the rate for courses outside London applies. You must show **£1,171** for each month of your course, for up to **9 months**. You must have had this money for **28 days** in a row. The last day of that 28-day period must fall within **31 days** of the date you apply.

This is money you show, not a fee the university charges. Amounts change, so confirm them on gov.uk before you apply.

### First-year example: MSc Computer Science

| Item | How it is worked out | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Tuition | Course fee, 2027-28 | £33,400 |
| Visa living money | £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee | Applying from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge | £776 for each year of your visa | £776 or more |
| **First-year total** | £33,400 + £10,539 + £558 + £776 | **at least £45,273** |

Your visa lasts longer than your course, so you usually pay for more than one year. A 16-month visa costs £1,164.

This is an example, not a budget. It leaves out flights, rent and everyday spending.

If you receive the £10,000 India Future Leaders award described below, tuition for this course falls to £23,400 (£33,400 − £10,000). The first-year total would then be at least £35,273 (£23,400 + £10,539 + £558 + £776).

Read the rules in our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To compare costs across UK universities, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

### Other visa documents

Besides the money, you need:

- **A CAS**, the Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies. Your course provider issues it, and you need it to apply.
- **A valid passport.**
- **English at CEFR level B2 or above** for degree study. CEFR is a common scale for language levels. Your university can assess your English itself. If it does not, you need an approved English test result.
- **A TB test, if you need one.** India is on the UK list of countries where the test applies. You need the test if all three of these are true: you are coming to the UK for 6 months or more; you have lived in a listed country for 6 months or more; you were living in a listed country within the last 6 months. The test must be done at a clinic approved by the Home Office.
- **An ATAS certificate, if your course needs one.** ATAS is the Academic Technology Approval Scheme. You must have it before you start the course. It can take 8 to 10 weeks.

You can apply for the visa no earlier than 6 months before your course starts.

## Ways to reduce the cost

Newcastle lists these awards for international students on its global scholarships page.

- **India Future Leaders Scholarship.** A **£10,000** tuition fee award. It is automatic, so there is no separate application. To qualify, you must be domiciled in India (your permanent home is in India), have an offer for 2027/28, pay the deposit in full by **2 August 2027**, and be assessed as an international student for fees. Check the award page for the courses it covers.
- **Vice-Chancellor's International award.** An **£8,000** tuition fee award. It is automatic once you apply for a course. You must accept your offer and pay the deposit in full by **2 August 2027**. The Vice-Chancellor is the university's head.
- **Vice-Chancellor's Excellence scholarship.** Up to **50%** off tuition. Apply through the scholarships section of the Apply to Newcastle portal by **8 June 2027**.

The MSc Computer Science course page says you may be eligible for a scholarship worth **25%** off the international fee. The page does not name the award, so check the course page to see who qualifies.

MBA applicants are also considered for MBA scholarships at interview. Ask the admissions team about the amount.

## Getting in

Each course sets its own degree rule. A UK honours degree comes in classes. A **2:1** (upper second) is a higher class than a **2:2** (lower second).

- **MSc Computer Science:** a 2:2 honours degree, or equivalent, in any subject except those related to computer science.
- **MSc Data Science:** a 2:2 honours degree, or international equivalent, plus GCSE Mathematics grade 6 or equivalent. GCSE is a school exam taken in the UK.
- **MBA:** a 2:1 honours degree, or international equivalent, plus at least three years of managerial work experience.

**Indian degrees.** On each course page, select India under "Qualifications from outside the UK" to see the grade table. It shows:

- For a 2:1, the grade table has three sections that depend on the university you studied at: Section 1 is **60%** or a CGPA of **6.0** out of 10, Section 2 is **62%** or **6.2**, and Section 3 is **65%** or **6.5**.
- For a 2:2, it asks for **58%** in Section 1, **60%** in Section 2 and **63%** in Section 3.

CGPA means cumulative grade point average, the 10-point scale that many Indian universities use.

**English.** Newcastle asks for IELTS, an English test that gives you a score for each part. The university's general rule is an IELTS overall score of **6.5**, with at least **5.5** in each part. Check the entry requirements on your course page, because they show the scores for your course.

## Deadlines

| Course | Start | Application closing date | Tuition deposit for students from India |
|---|---|---|---|
| MSc Computer Science | September 2027 | No closing date | £3,000, or sponsorship letter, by 27 August 2027 |
| MSc Data Science | September 2027 | No closing date | £3,000, or sponsorship letter, by 27 August 2027 |
| MBA | September 2027 | No closing date | £3,000, or sponsorship letter, by 27 August 2027 |

If your course needs an ATAS certificate, the deposit date is 13 August 2027.

Scholarship dates are separate. The India Future Leaders award and the Vice-Chancellor's International award need the deposit paid in full by 2 August 2027. The Vice-Chancellor's Excellence scholarship closes on 8 June 2027.

Newcastle advises you to apply two months before the course starts. Start the visa early as well. You can apply no earlier than 6 months before the start, and an ATAS certificate can take 8 to 10 weeks.

## Courses covered in this guide

- [MSc Computer Science](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/postgraduate/degrees/5055f/): 12 months full time, starting September 2027.
- [MSc Data Science](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/postgraduate/degrees/5543f/): 12 months full time, starting September 2027. The GCSE Mathematics rule above applies to this course.
- [MBA](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/postgraduate/degrees/5823f/): 12 months full time, starting September 2027. It needs work experience, as set out above.

The same department also runs the [Advanced Computer Science MSc](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/postgraduate/degrees/5178f/).

## Where you'll live

The School of Computing is based in the Urban Sciences Building at Newcastle Helix. The India Future Leaders award page refers to the Newcastle city centre campus.

Newcastle's postgraduate accommodation page gives a guarantee deadline of 30 June 2026 for the 2026 cycle. The 2027 deadline is not published yet. Check the [postgraduate accommodation page](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/accommodation/applying-for-accommodation/applying-for-postgraduate-accommodation/) for the current deadline, and the [room types page](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/accommodation/university/types/our-rooms/) for the rooms on offer.

## Who it's a good fit for

**A strong choice if:**

- You have a 2:2 or better in a subject other than computing, and you want a one-year computer science master's.
- You have a 2:1 and at least three years of managerial work experience, and you want an MBA.
- You can pay the £3,000 deposit, or send a sponsorship letter, by 27 August 2027.

**Think carefully if:**

- You hold a computer science degree. The MSc Computer Science course does not accept degrees related to computer science.
- Your Indian degree is below the 58% or CGPA 5.8 level in the grade table.
- You cannot show £1,171 a month for up to 9 months, held for 28 days in a row.

To compare costs with other options, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

faq_json.q: How much is tuition at Newcastle University for Indian students?
faq_json.a: For 2027-28 entry, international tuition is £33,400 a year for MSc Computer Science, £32,800 for MSc Data Science and £34,400 for the MBA. Each course lasts 12 months full time.

faq_json.q: What grade do I need from India for Newcastle University?
faq_json.a: The grade table has three sections that depend on your university. For a 2:1 it asks for 60%, 62% or 65% (a CGPA of 6.0, 6.2 or 6.5 out of 10). For a 2:2 it asks for 58%, 60% or 63%. Select India on the course page to see which section applies.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score does Newcastle University ask for?
faq_json.a: The university's general rule is IELTS 6.5 overall, with at least 5.5 in each part. Check the entry requirements on your course page for the scores that apply to your course.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students at Newcastle?
faq_json.a: Yes. The India Future Leaders Scholarship is a £10,000 tuition fee award. It is automatic for students domiciled in India who have an offer for 2027/28 and pay the deposit in full by 2 August 2027. Check the award page for the courses it covers.

faq_json.q: How much money do I need to show for the UK student visa at Newcastle?
faq_json.a: Newcastle is outside London, so you show £1,171 for each month of your course, for up to 9 months. For a 12-month course that is £10,539, and you must have held it for 28 days in a row.

faq_json.q: When is the Newcastle tuition deposit due for students from India?
faq_json.a: The £3,000 deposit, or an official sponsorship letter, is due by 27 August 2027. If your course needs an ATAS certificate, the date is 13 August 2027.
